description.value: VIRL: Comox Branch is a public library operated by Vancouver Island Regional Library, housed in the Portside building on Beaufort Avenue just two blocks from the Comox waterfront. The branch has served the community since 1937 and moved to its current location in 2009, making it a long-established landmark in the heart of town. It offers a comfortable, accessible public space with free WiFi and air conditioning—a practical rest point for cyclists passing through Comox.
